title: Mapping configuration output
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape machine, and let $f$ map symbols to optional symbols. The mapped configuration keeps the state, input-head position, work-tape contents, and work-head positions of $c$; its output is obtained by applying $f$ to each output symbol in order and omitting the symbols for which $f$ returns no value.
hypotheses_covered: A function from symbols to optional symbols
